board.name: Nevada State Board of Medical Examiners (PAs supervised by MDs; PAs supervised by DOs are licensed by the Nevada State Board of Osteopathic Medicine under NRS 633)

licence.title: Physician Assistant (PA) licence
licence.renewalDeadline: June 30 of odd-numbered years (biennial period July 1 to June 30; current period ends June 30, 2027)

ce.categoryRules: 40 hours per biennium (prorated 30/20/10 if first licensed in the second, third or fourth six-month block), all AAPA Category 1, AMA PRA Category 1 or Board approved. Board summary: at least 20 hours within scope of practice or specialty (prorated 15/10/5) and at least 2 hours Ethics, Pain Management or Addiction Care every biennium. Mandated SBIRT, controlled substance, HIV stigma and cultural competency hours count toward the total (NAC 630.358(4), 630.3585(2)).
ce.nccpaCertificationRequiredForRenewal: not confirmed (NCCPA certification is a licensure qualification and involuntary loss must be reported within 30 days)

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 2 hours each licensure period on substance use disorders and opioid prescribing for PAs registered to dispense controlled substances (NRS 630.2535).

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Before providing services, the PA files a Board form naming practice location and supervising physician, signed by both; termination of supervision must be reported within 72 hours and a new notice filed before practice resumes.
practice.notes: Supervising physician must be available for consultation at all times (may be by telephone), review selected charts, and spend part of a day at least monthly at a site where the PA practices. PA services are limited to the supervising physician's specialty area. PA may only prescribe controlled substance schedules the supervising physician may prescribe.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Certificate of registration from the Nevada State Board of Pharmacy (NRS 639.1373), which requires passing a pharmacy law examination; CS dispensing registration is renewed biennially (NRS 453.226)
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 2 hours per licensure period on substance use disorders and opioid prescribing if registered to dispense controlled substances (NRS 630.2535).

aprn.title: APRN (Advanced Practice Registered Nurse)
aprn.renewalDeadline: Same date as RN licence (birthday, biennial)
aprn.ceNotes: 45 hours directly related to role or population of focus; may include the RN renewal CE (30 hours). Must include the 2 controlled substance hours (if prescribing or dispensing CS) and the suicide prevention hours when due. As a chapter 632 licensee the APRN also carries the RN mandates (4 hours cultural competency every biennium, one-time 4-hour WMD course, HIV stigma if in emergency or primary care). APRNs must also maintain a portfolio subject to audit (NAC 632.291(3), 632.2563). No separate pharmacology hour requirement.
aprn.nationalCertificationRequired: yes if the APRN program was completed on or after July 1, 2014

unverified: PA: whether current NCCPA certification is checked at each renewal is unconfirmed. NAC 630.280(5) makes it a licensure qualification, NAC 630.380(1)(k) requires reporting an involuntary loss within 30 days, and the status-change form asks about it, but NAC 630.350 lists only CME for renewal.
PA: weapons of mass destruction course (NAC 630.353) still in the NAC but absent from the Board's current CME summary, current PA reinstatement form and NRS 630.253; treat as not yet verified.
PA: suicide prevention applies to PAs per Board documents; the statute (NRS 630.253(5)) and NAC 630.1545 name only holders of a licence to practice medicine.
PA: the 20-hour scope-of-practice minimum comes from the Board's CME summary (applies to all licensee types); it is not in NAC 630.350 and is not on the current PA reinstatement form.
PA: PAs supervised by osteopathic physicians are licensed by the Nevada State Board of Osteopathic Medicine (NRS 633 / NAC 633); those requirements were not researched or verified.

NP: 'full' practice authority is derived from NRS 632.237 (no standing collaboration requirement; Schedule II limited before 2 years or 2,000 hours unless under a collaborating physician protocol); no board page using the word 'full' was loaded.

Missed-mandate sweep: NRS 630, NAC 630, NRS 632 and NAC 632 were searched; no implicit bias, human trafficking, child abuse CE, end of life, Alzheimer (only double-credit incentive for PAs), infection control or domestic violence CE requirement was found for PAs or APRNs.

corrections: PA categoryRules: added the Board summary's prorated scope-of-practice minimum (20/15/10/5) and that mandated SBIRT, controlled substance and HIV hours count toward the 40 (NAC 630.358(4), 630.3585(2)).

PA weapons of mass destruction course: changed from verified to NOT YET VERIFIED as currently enforced. NAC 630.353 is still in the NAC, but NRS 630.253 (rev. 9/9/2026) no longer contains it and the Board's current CME summary and 2025-2027 PA reinstatement form omit it. Hours set to 4 from the Board's older status-change form, flagged.
PA suicide prevention: confirmed the Board applies it to PAs (current 2025-2027 PA reinstatement form cites NRS 630.253(5) for PAs) while the statute text names only physicians; recorded both.

PA prescribing: loaded NRS 639.1373 and NRS 453.226 directly (researcher had only cross references). Added that the Board of Pharmacy certificate requires a pharmacy law exam and the CS registration is biennial with proof of PDMP access.

NP: added the HIV stigma fact (NRS 632.343(3)(e)) that was in topicMandates but had no fact row, the NRS 639.2351 pharmacy registration fact, and statutory support for non-membership in the NLC (the Board FAQ cited was dated 2023).
NP: noted the RN first-biennium exemption (NRS 632.343(1)), that the cultural competency, WMD and HIV mandates apply to APRN licensees too, and the APRN portfolio audit (NAC 632.291(3)).
